description: Clean a list of up to 1,000 addresses in one call with quick checks (no mail server is contacted): returns `keep`, `review` (role, free, parked, new or typo addresses, with a reason) and `remove` (cannot receive mail), plus `counts`. $0.001 per well-formed address. Run email_verify on the kept addresses you will actually send to.
name: email_clean_list
title: Clean Email List
